paper.title: BindGPT: A Scalable Framework for 3D Molecular Design via Language Modeling and Reinforcement Learning

result.summary: BindGPT 是一个将 3D 分子设计表述为文本生成的语言模型框架，用结构 SMILES 加空间 XYZ 格式同时描述分子图和原子坐标，从而无需外部软件重建分子图 [S1.p5][S3.SS1.p2]。作者在大规模 3D 分子与口袋数据上预训练，再在 CrossDocked 与 GEOM-DRUGS 上监督微调，并用对接软件奖励做强化学习 [S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p2]。实验表明该模型可同时用于 3D 分子生成、构象生成和口袋条件生成，在多个指标上匹配或超过专门的扩散模型、语言模型和图神经网络，且采样成本低约两个数量级 [S4.SS1.p3][S4.SS2.p3][S5.p1]。作者认为这显示大规模预训练范式可从 NLP 迁移到 3D 药物发现 [S5.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的核心问题是：如何用一个概念简单、无领域等变假设的生成模型，在蛋白质结合位点内直接生成 3D 分子，并同时输出分子图与构象 [S1.p3][S1.p5]。作者指出，多数空间分子生成器只关注原子类型和位置，依赖 OpenBabel 等外部工具重建化学键，而原子位置的微小偏差可能显著改变重建的键甚至使分子图断裂 [S1.p2]。其动机还包括：现有口袋条件生成受限于 3D 结合构象数据规模较小，因而大量使用 SE(3) 等变等专门架构 [S2.p2]。

evidence.quote: In this work, we introduce a novel framework that applies language modeling to the domain of 3D molecular data represented by textual tokens.
It uses structural SMILES and spatial XYZ formats to describe molecular graphs and atom locations, eliminating the dependency on external software for graph reconstruction.
They depend on supplementary tools, such as OpenBabel, for the critical task of bond reconstruction.
minor positional adjustments can significantly alter reconstructed molecular bonds or even make the molecular graph disconnected.
The challenge with pocket-conditioned molecular generation arises from a relatively small size of existing 3D binding poses datasets

method.text: 方法核心是把多种 3D 分子设计任务统一表述为带提示的文本生成：将条件 token 放在待生成对象 token 之前，例如用蛋白质口袋作为口袋条件生成的提示、用 2D 分子结构作为构象生成的提示 [S3.p1]。模型采用 decoder-only 的 GPT-NeoX 架构并使用旋转位置嵌入以支持长度泛化 [S3.SS1.p1]。表示上，作者把 XYZ 格式与 SMILES 耦合，强制两者原子顺序一致，并从 XYZ 中移除原子符号，以避免依赖外部工具重建分子图 [S3.SS1.p2]。训练流程包括在大规模 3D 分子与口袋数据上预训练、在 CrossDocked 等数据上监督微调，以及用外部对接软件奖励进行 REINFORCE 强化学习 [S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p2]。

evidence.quote: The main principle in our approach is to formulate several 3D molecular design task as prompted generation of text.
we layout the tokens of a condition before the tokens of the object to generate
we follow the decoder-only paradigm in Language Models and use the GPT-NeoX
architecture that utilizes rotary position embeddings. This technique allows for the length generalization
we propose to couple the XYZ format with the SMILES format.
we enforce to have the same atom ordering in both. We also remove the atom symbol from the XYZ representation
we use a large-scale but specialized dataset of 3D molecules and protein pockets.
During the supervised fine-tuning phase, we continue model training on CrossDocked 2020
We apply the REINFORCE algorithm for further model finetuning.

experiments.text: 预训练使用 Uni-Mol 作者提出的大规模 3D 分子数据集，包含 12M 分子的 208M 个构象和 3.2M 个蛋白质口袋空间结构 [S4.p2]。口袋条件生成微调使用 CrossDocked，作者过滤后得到约 27M 个口袋-配体对，覆盖 14k 分子与 3k 口袋的交叉组合，并留出 100 个口袋用于评估 [S4.p2]。3D 分子与构象生成任务还在 GEOM-DRUGS 上微调，该数据集包含 300k 分子的 27M 个构象，并以 Platinum 数据集作为零样本构象生成的留出评估集 [S4.p2]。评估指标包括有效性、SA、QED、Lipinski、分布度量、RMSD、生成 1K 个有效 3D 分子的时间，以及构象生成的 RMSD-coverage [S4.SS1.p1]；口袋条件任务使用 QVINA 计算的结合能和药物相似性指标 [S4.SS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: The dataset contains 208M conformations for 12M molecules and 3.2M spatial structures of protein pockets.
Our filtration of the dataset has around 27M pocket-ligand pairs covering a cross product of 14k molecules with 3k pockets
We also hold out a set of 100 pockets from the training data for evaluating the model performance.
we also finetune the model on the GEOM-DRUGS dataset
This dataset contains 27M conformations for 300k molecules
we use the Platinum dataset as a hold-out evaluation dataset to test our model and baselines on zero-shot conformer generation.
We provide the validity ( $\uparrow$) of generated molecules and druglikeness metrics - SA ( $\uparrow$), QED ( $\uparrow$), and Lipinski ( $\uparrow$)
Finally, we measure the time needed to generate 1K valid 3D molecules on one GPU.
For the 3D conformation generation given molecule task, we compute the RMSD-coverage ( $\uparrow$) metric.
The first one is represented via the binding energy ( $\downarrow$) computed by the QVINA docking software

findings.text: 预训练的 BindGPT 在不含和含显式氢两种设置下都持续优于 XYZ-TF 基线，并且是首个能在如此大规模下显式建模氢的模型 [S4.SS1.p3]。在 GEOM-DRUGS 上微调后，BindGPT 在几乎所有分布评估指标上达到当前最优，但在药物相似性上未超过 MolDiff，作者认为这可能与词表较小、只含常见原子有关 [S4.SS1.p3]。构象生成任务中，Uni-Mol 未能泛化到 Platinum 数据集，而 BindGPT 在 RDKit 辅助下可匹配 Torsional Diffusion，无辅助时差距较小 [S4.SS1.p3]。口袋条件生成中，经 RL 微调的模型在结合能上显著优于此前最佳基线 [S4.SS2.p3]。作者总结该方法在多个任务上匹配或超过基线，且采样成本低约两个数量级 [S5.p1][S1.p5]。

evidence.quote: the pretrained BindGPT model consistently outperforms the XYZ-TF baseline both without and with explicit hydrogens.
BindGPT is the first model capable of modeling hydrogen explicitly at such large scale.
BindGPT (being finetuned on this data) shows state-of-the-art performance scores for nearly all distributional evaluation metrics.
Even though BindGPT does not outperform MolDiff in Druglikeness, that could be explained by a smaller vocabulary of the, containing only frequent atoms.
Surprisingly, Uni-Mol fails to generalize to this new dataset (even assisted by RDKit)
BindGPT, in contrast, is capable of matching the performance of TD when assisted by the RDKit tool and having a small gap when not.
the RL finetuned model can learn to search the space of binding molecules much more efficiently and significantly outperforms all the previous best baselines in terms of the binding energy.
we demonstrate the generality of our approach as it can solve each of them by matching or surpassing the baselines.
The method offers comparable generation quality to leading approaches with the speedup of up to $100$ x.

limitations.text: 作者指出，在 GEOM-DRUGS 上微调后 BindGPT 在药物相似性指标上未超过 MolDiff，并推测这可能与词表较小、只含常见原子有关 [S4.SS1.p3]。作者还报告，在 CrossDocked 的 1% 版本乃至完整版本上训练时观察到明显的过拟合，因此采用 SMILES 随机化和随机旋转两种数据增强来缓解 [S3.SS3.SSS1.p1]。此外，作者在模型规模实验中发现模型在 300M 参数之前扩展良好，之后困惑度显示过拟合，因此后续实验采用 100M 模型 [A3.p1]。

evidence.quote: Even though BindGPT does not outperform MolDiff in Druglikeness, that could be explained by a smaller vocabulary of the, containing only frequent atoms.
we observed an dramatic overfitting when training on the $1\%$ version of CrossDocked and even on the full one.
To alleviate that, we resort to two standard augmentation techniques used in drug discovery.
we observed that the model scales well up until the size of 300M parameters, where its perplexity shows overfitting.
We, therefore, stick to the 100M model in our later experiments as we found it yielding the best results.
